matching: Same exact game/player/target/label across C0/C1/C2. Full coverage plus learned/NGS subsets. A/B exact comparison unestablished absent their row exports. 107-game2026schedule verify.
fallback: Under40eligible training rows use own historical median then sameposition eligible training median then literal0. Counts projected>=0; yards signed. Same all arms.
objectives: MAE primary, squared point error diagnostics not asserted conditional mean; no HGB probability law. Count exact unrounded; strict<1/inclusive<=1 nativeunit. Bias/tails/weekly season startup views.
offers: No C-accessible qualified offers at registration. P1 and P2 N/A, no synthetic offers/prices. Import exact records in future version; no current-fit outcome choice.
uncertainty: 500 paired game/week bootstrap replicates seed1701, 95%descriptive intervals, fixed membership, no multiplicity correction; all seasons exposed research.
